reference: She could have laughed, but she just raised her eyebrows.
sk: Mohla sa zasmiať, ale len zdvihla obočie.
cz: Mohla se zasmát, ale jen zvedla obočí.
acceptable: She could have laughed, but {she |}{just|only|simply} {raised|lifted} her eyebrows.

mistakes.text: She could laugh, but she {just|only} raised her eyebrows.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nevyužitá možnosť v minulosti je „could have“ + tretí tvar: „could have laughed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nevyužitá možnost v minulosti je „could have“ + příčestí minulé: „could have laughed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A past chance that didn't happen needs “could have” + past participle: “could have laughed”.

mistakes.text: She could have laugh, but she {just|only} raised her eyebrows.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “could have” use the past participle: “laughed”.

mistakes.text: She could have laughed, but she {just|only} {raises|raise} her eyebrows.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Druhá časť je minulý dej: Past Simple „raised“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Druhá část je minulý děj: Past Simple „raised“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The second part is a finished past action: use the Past Simple “raised”.

mistakes.text: She was able to laugh, but she {just|only} raised her eyebrows.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Was able to“ znamená, že sa to podarilo. Nevyužitú možnosť vyjadruje „could have laughed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Was able to“ znamená, že se to podařilo. Nevyužitou možnost vyjadřuje „could have laughed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Was able to” means she actually did it. An unused chance is “could have laughed”.

mistakes.text: She might have laughed, but she {just|only} raised her eyebrows.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Might have“ je skôr dohad. „Mohla, ale neurobila“ presnejšie vyjadruje „could have“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Might have“ je spíš dohad. „Mohla, ale neudělala“ přesněji vyjadřuje „could have“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Might have” sounds like a guess; for a chance she didn't take, “could have” is more exact.

mistakes.text: She could have laughed, but she {just|only} raised eyebrows.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri častiach tela treba privlastňovacie zámeno: „her eyebrows“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U částí těla je potřeba přivlastňovací zájmeno: „her eyebrows“.
mistakes.feedback_en: English uses a possessive with body parts: “her eyebrows”.
